mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to "a syntactically heterogeneous class of expressions which are distinguished by their function in discourse and the kind of meaning they encode" (Blakemore 2006:221)."

Discourse Marker (DM) generally refers to "a syntactically heterogeneous class of expressions which are distinguished by their function in discourse and the kind of meaning they encode" (Blakemore 2006:221).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that speakers routinely utter which contain words and phrases that are not syntactically embedded in any sentences, and do perform speech acts like asserting, asking, commanding, promising etc."

Non-sentence expressions are those that speakers routinely utter which contain words and phrases that are not syntactically embedded in any sentences, and do perform speech acts like asserting, asking, commanding, promising etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as communicative act of indicating."
Display in this context is referred to as communicative act of indicating.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as the Field which is the total event in which the text (or utterance) is functioning."
The ongoing activity is referred to as the Field which is the total event in which the text (or utterance) is functioning.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of verbal or written "pointing to" or identifying (picking out) of certain objects or individuals that a speaker wishes to talk about."
Semantic reference is a type of verbal or written "pointing to" or identifying (picking out) of certain objects or individuals that a speaker wishes to talk about.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most appropriate way of sending a message that captures the speaker's intension and receives the best kind of response because the receiver feels the message soothes him."
Tact is the most appropriate way of sending a message that captures the speaker's intension and receives the best kind of response because the receiver feels the message soothes him.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unit of language in use (Halliday & Hasan 1976)."
A text is a unit of language in use (Halliday & Hasan 1976).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the breaking down and ordering of the data (quantitative information) involving searching for trends and patterns of association and relationships among data or group of them."
Analysis is the breaking down and ordering of the data (quantitative information) involving searching for trends and patterns of association and relationships among data or group of them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the extensive reading of materials on the subject area beginning from the old to the most recent literatures on the topic."
Review of Literature is the extensive reading of materials on the subject area beginning from the old to the most recent literatures on the topic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the present time, either at 8 am or 12 noon."
Again now in (iv) refers to the present time, either at 8 am or 12 noon.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that in inferring what S is saying, H also relies on the "presumption of literalness (PL)" i.e. "if S could (under the circumstances) be speaking literally, then S is speaking literally."

Inference (based on SAS) means that in inferring what S is saying, H also relies on the "presumption of literalness (PL)" i.e. "if S could (under the circumstances) be speaking literally, then S is speaking literally.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a product is a good researched topic, while a good topic is a product of a sound initial research on an area that is adequately familiar to the researcher."
A good project is a product is a good researched topic, while a good topic is a product of a sound initial research on an area that is adequately familiar to the researcher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the function of the text in the event, including the medium of expression."
The mode of discourse is the function of the text in the event, including the medium of expression.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an exercise in search of meanings."
Pragmatics is an exercise in search of meanings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as the tenor."
The role relationships are referred to as the tenor.
fib: ______ is the word or sentence; referent is the object (in the external world).
symbol
The symbol is the word or sentence; referent is the object (in the external world).
______ refers to the situation, within which language functions.
Context
Context refers to the situation, within which language functions.
______ are those functions that correspond to what the speaker or writer intends to achieve on the mind of the hearer or reader.
Illocutionary functions
Illocutionary functions are those functions that correspond to what the speaker or writer intends to achieve on the mind of the hearer or reader.
______ is the activity type investigating the structures and pragmatic properties of seminars/interviews or such that focus on power and distance.
Let's assume your research
Let's assume your research is the activity type investigating the structures and pragmatic properties of seminars/interviews or such that focus on power and distance.
______ is an exercise of language choices to create a context intended to match addressee's notion of how he or she should be addressed.
Politeness
Politeness is an exercise of language choices to create a context intended to match addressee's notion of how he or she should be addressed.
______ is concerned with a description of how people take turns and the circumstances under which they overlap or pause between them.
conversation analyst
A conversation analyst is concerned with a description of how people take turns and the circumstances under which they overlap or pause between them.
______ is a feature of a normal everyday discourse/conversation.
Presupposition
Presupposition is a feature of a normal everyday discourse/conversation.
______ is defined as the study of language in relation to the society (Hudson, 1980) while pragmatics is concerned with the study of language use in relation to the social context.
Sociolinguistics
Sociolinguistics is defined as the study of language in relation to the society (Hudson, 1980) while pragmatics is concerned with the study of language use in relation to the social context.
______ is the what, while performance is the how.
Content
Content is the what, while performance is the how.
______ is the process of working out meaning or the intention of the speaker from the text or utterance available to you.
Inference
Inference is the process of working out meaning or the intention of the speaker from the text or utterance available to you.
______ is an activity co-extensive with a period of speech while a football game is not.
one-on- one conversation
A one-on- one conversation is an activity co-extensive with a period of speech while a football game is not.
______ is the pragmatic use of language in such a way that protects other people's self image, self- esteem and self-respect.
Linguistic politeness
Linguistic politeness is the pragmatic use of language in such a way that protects other people's self image, self- esteem and self-respect.
______ is a predictable type of utterance which has regular inferred interpretation across a range of contexts (Grundy, 2000).
Utterance-type
Utterance-type is a predictable type of utterance which has regular inferred interpretation across a range of contexts (Grundy, 2000).
______ is a speech event like radio interview, telephone exchange, career talks or a debate.
conversation
A conversation is a speech event like radio interview, telephone exchange, career talks or a debate.
______ is used to point to locations e.g. here, there, beside, etc, while time deixis is used to point to time, e.g. now, then, this evening, tomorrow etc.
Place deixis
Place deixis is used to point to locations e.g. here, there, beside, etc, while time deixis is used to point to time, e.g. now, then, this evening, tomorrow etc.
